design_philosophy: A grounded, reliable, and clear interface for high-speed restaurant environments. Prioritizes legibility, warm inviting tones, and tactile feedback for cashiers.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense and compact for POS grid (Control Room grid), generous spacing for Admin Dashboard sections.

pos_button.base: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 h-24 rounded-lg border border-[#E5E2DC] bg-white transition-all shadow-sm

ticket_panel.base: bg-white border-l border-[#E5E2DC] h-full flex flex-col shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]

card.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E5E2DC] p-6 shadow-sm

images.description: Warm wooden cafe interior for the login screen background, set with a black/50 overlay for text contrast.
Minimalist coffee cup image to be used as a placeholder for menu items if image URLs are missing.

instructions_to_main_agent: DATA STORAGE: The app MUST be fully offline. Use localStorage or IndexedDB (via localforage or standard APIs) to store: Users, Menu Categories, Menu Items, Inventory Stock, and Sales Tickets.
ROLES & AUTH: Implement simple mock login. 'Admin' sees full Dashboard (Inventory, Menu Management, Z-Report). 'Cashier' sees POS and X-Report only.

POS SCREEN (CASHIER): Create a fast, tap-friendly grid of menu items categorized by tabs. Right sidebar holds the active ticket with quantity controls, subtotal, tax, total, and 'Pay Cash' / 'Pay Credit' action buttons.

REPORTS: 'X Report' calculates daily sales up to the current moment without clearing data. 'Z Report' calculates end-of-day sales, and upon confirming, clears the active daily totals and archives the record.
INVENTORY: Menu items must have a 'stock' count and 'low_stock_threshold'. Alert (visual badge/toast) when an item falls below the threshold upon ordering.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) using kebab-case role-based names.
STYLING: Strictly adhere to the Organic & Earthy palette. Avoid generic Bootstrap/Vercel looks. Use generous padding for Admin screens, dense functional grids for POS.
